namespace.description: A namespace determines resource IRIs: IRI = namespace IRI + machine name. Register at least one before modeling; namespaces still used by resources cannot be deleted.
namespace.prefixHint: Starts with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits, _ or - only, e.g. kg
namespace.prefixPattern: Prefix must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, _ or - (max 64)
namespace.iriHint: An http(s) address ending with # or /, e.g. https://example.org/kg#
namespace.iriPattern: Namespace IRI must be an http(s) address ending with # or /
namespace.duplicateIri: This namespace IRI is already registered
namespace.protectedHint: Protected core namespaces cannot be deleted
namespace.inUseHint: {count} resource(s) still use this namespace; it cannot be deleted
namespace.emptyHint: No namespace available yet. Click Register to add one; it will be selected automatically.

ontology.description: An ontology is the assembled artifact: entity types, relation types and business domains pinned to fixed revisions, forming one semantic graph. Create one and assemble it in the designer; publishing freezes every referenced revision.
ontology.nameImmutable: The machine name and IRI are the ontology identity and cannot change after creation.
ontology.createHint: You will be taken to the designer right away, where you drag entity and relation types onto the canvas.
ontology.namePattern: Machine name must start with an uppercase letter and contain only letters and digits
ontology.empty: No ontologies yet. Create one, or start from a template in Assembly Templates.

rules.intro: Manage standards-based and enterprise rules, save expressions, and check positive and negative examples.
rules.identifierTaken: This rule identifier is already in use. Choose another identifier.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Create a rule and record its source.
rules.editingRevision: Editing rule revision {revision}. Saving checks for concurrent changes.
rules.sourceHint: For standards, record the standard and clause identifiers with your own description. For enterprise rules, identify the internal source.
rules.shaclHint: Automatic checks support SHACL Core. Use Turtle expressions and examples with the declared target class IRI.
rules.notRunHint: No executor is connected for this mode. The result is Not run, which does not mean Pass.
rules.examplesHint: The positive example must conform and the negative example must violate the rule. Both must contain instances of the target class. These checks validate the examples, not overall standards conformance.
rules.saveBeforeTest: Save all changes before checking the current revision.
rules.staleTest: The expression or examples have changed. The report below belongs to the previously saved revision.
rules.examplesFailed: The actual example results differ from the expectations. Review the rule and examples.
rules.conflict: This rule has changed. Close and reopen the editor. Your changes have not overwritten the server copy.
rules.notFound: This rule does not exist or has been deleted. Refresh the list.
rules.invalid: The rule could not be processed. Check the expression and examples. Reason: {reason}
rules.requestFailed: Request failed. Please retry. Error code: {code}
rules.dataHint: expression is JSON config; ops: acyclic / sum_le / unique_attr / required_edge / date_format. AUTO data rules run in extraction stage 3; hits go to quarantine.
rules.derivationHint: expression is JSON config; ops: transitive / symmetric / co_occurrence / product_chain. AUTO derivation rules run in extraction stage 4 and produce derived edges with rule and source facts.
rules.examplesOptionalHint: Data and derivation rules are defined by their JSON expression; examples are optional.
